articles.title: James Gunn Gives a Fan's DC Timeline a Thumbs-Up — Almost
articles.summary: James Gunn praised a fan's timeline of the DC Universe on Threads, calling it "pretty good" without fully endorsing it.

articles.title: Djokovic's Season Ends With a Surprise Defeat in Paris
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic lost to qualifier Rinky Hijikata in Paris, ending his hopes of reaching the ATP Finals in Turin.

articles.title: Bob Dylan Comes Knockin' on the Pope's Door
articles.summary: Bob Dylan met Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican on Wednesday, a brief visit between concert dates in Italy.
